description: For every extended sentence \(A\), the actual derivation checker accepts a proof of \(A\to A\) with empty context.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.CodingFormalProofs.identity_record.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (S : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.EffectiveSignature L) (A : L.Formula ℕ) :
  ∃ d,
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.Der S d (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.contextCode S [])
      (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.namedCode S (A.imp A))
